title.zh: 卷二十九 本紀第二十九 高宗六
title.raw: 卷二十九 本紀第二十九 高宗六 Volume 29 Annals 29: Gaozong 6

sentences.zh: 八年春正月戊子朔，帝在建康。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, wuzi new moon: the Emperor was at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 8, spring, wuzi new moon: Gaozong held court at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，減臨安府夏稅折輸錢。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Lin'an prefecture's summer-tax commuted transport money was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Lin'an's summer-tax commuted payments were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，張守罷。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Zhang Shou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhang Shou left office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，偽齊知壽州宋超率兵民來歸。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: puppet Qi's Shou prefecture intendant Song Chao led troops and people to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, puppet Qi's Shou intendant Song Chao brought troops and people over.

sentences.zh: 蔡州提轄白安時殺金將兀魯，執其守劉永壽來降。

translations.literal: Cai prefecture controller Bai Anshi killed Jin general Wulu and seized defender Liu Yongshou to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Cai controller Bai Anshi killed the Jin general Wulu, took defender Liu Yongshou, and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔以方議和好，禁沿海州郡遣人過淮招納。

translations.literal: An edict, peace being discussed, forbade coastal prefectures and commanderies to send men across the Huai to recruit.
translations.idiomatic: With peace under discussion, coastal prefectures were forbidden to send men across the Huai to recruit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大閱張俊軍。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Zhang Jun's army was reviewed in grand muster.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhang Jun's army was mustered in grand review.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以兵部侍郎胡世將爲四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Military Affairs Vice Minister Hu Shijiang was made Sichuan pacification and disposition grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Military Affairs Vice Minister Hu Shijiang became Sichuan pacification and disposition grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，劉錡入見。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: Liu Qi had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuwu: Liu Qi was received.

sentences.zh: 減建康府夏稅折輸錢，蠲民戶逋租、和市科調。

translations.literal: Jiankang prefecture's summer-tax commuted transport money was reduced; households' arrears of rent, harmonized purchase, and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang's summer commuted tax was cut; rent arrears, harmonized purchase, and levies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚申，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 以呂頤浩爲江東安撫制置大使兼行宮留守。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao was made Jiangdong pacification and disposition grand commissioner with concurrent mobile-palace keeper.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao became Jiangdong pacification grand commissioner and mobile-palace keeper.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，岳飛乞增兵，不許。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Yue Fei begged for more troops; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yue Fei asked for more troops and was refused.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝發建康。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Emperor left Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the court left Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以胡安國《春秋傳》成書，進寶文閣直學士。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: because Hu Anguo's Spring and Autumn Annals commentary was completed, he was advanced to Direct Academician of the Baowen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Hu Anguo's Spring and Autumn commentary was finished; he was made Direct Baowen Pavilion Academician.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，帝至臨安。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Emperor reached Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the court reached Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以戶部尚書章誼爲江東安撫制置大使兼行宮留守，呂頤浩爲醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Revenue Minister Zhang Yi was made Jiangdong pacification and disposition grand commissioner with concurrent mobile-palace keeper; Lü Yihao was made Liquan Abbey commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhang Yi became Jiangdong pacification grand commissioner and palace keeper; Lü Yihao became Liquan Abbey commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，減紹興府和市絹萬匹。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Shaoxing prefecture's harmonized-purchase silk of ten thousand bolts was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Shaoxing's harmonized-purchase silk levy was cut by ten thousand bolts.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，以知南外宗正事仲儡嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Zhongruai, knowing director of the Southern Outer Imperial Clan, succeeded as Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jichou: Southern Outer Clan director Zhongruai succeeded as Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以禮部尚書劉大中參知政事，兵部尚書王庶爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Rites Minister Liu Dazhong was made Vice Grand Councilor; Military Affairs Minister Wang Shu was made Privy Council Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Dazhong of Rites became Vice Grand Councilor; Wang Shu of Military Affairs became Privy Council Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復以秦檜爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Qin Hui was again made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, co-equal councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and concurrent controller of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Qin Hui was restored as Right Vice Director, co-equal councillor, and concurrent Military Affairs controller.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陳與義罷。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Chen Yuyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Chen Yuyi left office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，增夔州路路分都監一員，修治關隘，練義兵。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: one Kuizhou route circuit controller was added; passes were repaired; righteous militia were drilled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Kuizhou route gained a circuit controller; passes were mended and righteous militia drilled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，蠲農器及牛稅。

translations.literal: Day jihai: farm-tool and ox taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, farm-tool and ox taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以李天祚爲靜海軍節度使、交趾郡王。

translations.literal: Li Tianzuo was made Jinghai army military commissioner and King of Jiaozhi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tianzuo became Jinghai military commissioner and King of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，定以故相韓忠彥配享徽宗廟廷。

translations.literal: Day renyin: it was fixed that the former chief minister Han Zhongyan should share sacrifice in Huizong's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, former chief minister Han Zhongyan was fixed to share sacrifice in Huizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 丁未，蠲所過州縣民積欠稅賦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: accumulated tax arrears of the people in prefectures and counties the court passed through were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, tax arrears in every prefecture and county the court passed through were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蠲江西、湖南諸州月椿錢各萬緡。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Jiangxi and Hunan commanderies' monthly pile money, each ten thousand strings, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Jiangxi and Hunan monthly pile levies of ten thousand strings each were cut.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命考核川、陝宣撫司便宜所授官，冒濫尤甚者悉與裁減。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: offices granted on expedient authority by the Chuan-Shaan pacification commission were to be examined; the most egregiously excessive were all to be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Chuan-Shaan expedient appointments were to be audited; the worst excesses were to be cut.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，初置戶部和糴場于臨安。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: the Revenue Ministry's grain-purchase office was first set at Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengshen: the Revenue Ministry's grain-purchase office was first opened at Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣王庶巡視江、淮邊防。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Wang Shu was sent to inspect Jiang and Huai frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wang Shu was sent to inspect the Jiang and Huai frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，復置六路發運司。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the six-route transport commission was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the six-route transport commission was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔三衙管軍輪宿禁中。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict ordered the three palace armies' commanders to rotate night watch in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the three palace armies were told to rotate night watch inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，詔鎮江府募橫江軍千人。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: an edict ordered Zhenjiang prefecture to recruit one thousand Cross-River troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengxu: Zhenjiang was told to recruit one thousand Cross-River troops.

sentences.zh: 竄內侍羅亶于海島。

translations.literal: Inner attendant Luo Dan was banished to a sea island.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendant Luo Dan was exiled to a sea island.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禁貧民不舉子，其不能育者給錢養之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the poor were forbidden to abandon infants; those unable to rear them were given money to support them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, abandoning infants was forbidden; the destitute who could not rear a child were given support money.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貶劉子羽爲單州團練副使、漳州安置。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Liu Ziyu was demoted to Dan prefecture militia training vice commissioner and assigned to Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Liu Ziyu was demoted to Dan militia training vice commissioner and sent to Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金國使烏陵思謀、石慶充與王倫等偕來。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Jin envoys Wulinsi Mou and Shi Qingchong came together with Wang Lun and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Jin envoys Wulinsi Mou and Shi Qingchong arrived with Wang Lun and others.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以資政殿學士葉夢得爲江東安撫制置大使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Ye Mengde was made Jiangdong pacification and disposition grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Ye Mengde became Jiangdong pacification and disposition grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王庶至淮南，檄張宗顏將兵七千屯廬州，巨師古三千屯太平州，分韓世忠軍屯泗州及天長縣。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wang Shu reached Huainan, ordered Zhang Zongyan to lead seven thousand troops to camp at Luzhou, Ju Shigu three thousand at Taiping prefecture, and Han Shizhong's army was split to camp at Sizhou and Tianchang county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Shu reached Huainan, posted Zhang Zongyan with seven thousand at Luzhou, Ju Shigu with three thousand at Taiping, and split Han Shizhong's men between Sizhou and Tianchang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，賜衍聖公孔玠衢州田五頃，奉先聖祠事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: the Duke of Yan, Confucius Zhi, was given five qing of land at Quzhou to maintain the sage's shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: Duke of Yan Kong Zhi was given five qing at Quzhou for the sage's shrine.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，趙鼎上《重修哲宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Zhao Ding presented the Revised Veritable Records of Emperor Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhao Ding presented the Revised Veritable Records of Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜禮部進士黃公度以下三百九十五人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day renshen: three hundred ninety-five men from jinshi Huang Gongdu downward were given passage and origin.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, three hundred ninety-five men from Huang Gongdu downward received passage and origin.

sentences.zh: 王庶自淮南還入見。

translations.literal: Wang Shu returned from Huainan and had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shu came back from Huainan and was received.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以中護軍統制張宗顏知廬州，命劉錡率兵移屯鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Central Guard Army controller Zhang Zongyan was made Luzhou intendant; Liu Qi was ordered to lead troops and shift camp to Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Zongyan became Luzhou intendant; Liu Qi was told to march his troops to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，烏陵思謀、石慶充入見。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Wulinsi Mou and Shi Qingchong had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wulinsi Mou and Shi Qingchong were received.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉朔，復命王倫及藍公佐奉迎梓宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou new moon: Wang Lun and Lan Gongzuo were again ordered to welcome the imperial coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiyou new moon: Wang Lun and Lan Gongzuo were again sent to welcome the coffin.

sentences.zh: 錄司馬光曾孫伋補承務郎。

translations.literal: Sima Guang's great-grandson Ji was enrolled as Assistant Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang's great-grandson Ji was given Assistant Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，彗出東方。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a comet rose in the east.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，詔：「日者遣使報聘鄰國，期還梓宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu: an edict said: "We lately sent envoys to return courtesy to a neighboring state, expecting the coffin's return.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuwu: an edict said: "We lately sent envoys to our neighbor, expecting the coffin home.

sentences.zh: 尚慮邊臣未諭，遂馳戎備，以疑衆心。

translations.literal: We still fear frontier officers have not understood and have rushed war preparations, sowing doubt in every heart.
translations.idiomatic: We still fear the frontier has not heard us and has rushed to arms, sowing doubt in every heart.

sentences.zh: 其各嚴飭屬城，明告部曲，臨事必戒，無忘捍禦。

translations.literal: Each of you must strictly order your subordinate cities, plainly tell your commands, be ever wary in action, and do not forget defense."
translations.idiomatic: Each of you must tighten your cities, tell your commands plainly, stay wary in the field, and do not forget defense."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，蠲江東路月椿錢萬三千緡有奇。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Jiangdong route's monthly pile money of more than thirteen thousand strings was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Jiangdong's monthly pile levy of more than thirteen thousand strings was cut.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，彗滅。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the comet died.

sentences.zh: 遣監察御史李寀宣諭江西，措置盜賊。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Li Can was sent to announce and settle Jiangxi bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Li Can was sent to Jiangxi to announce policy and settle bandits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，劉大中罷。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi: Liu Dazhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingsi: Liu Dazhong left office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，趙鼎罷。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zhao Ding was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhao Ding left office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day yihai: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，金國使張通古、蕭哲與王倫皆來。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Jin envoys Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe came with Wang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Jin envoys Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe arrived with Wang Lun.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠乞奏事行在，不許。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong begged to memorialize at the mobile court; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong asked to report at court and was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樞密副使王庶乞免簽書和議文字，累疏求去，不許。

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Director Wang Shu begged to be excused from signing peace documents, repeatedly memorializing to leave; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council Vice Director Wang Shu refused to sign the peace papers, memorializing again and again to quit; the throne would not let him go.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，以翰林學士承旨孫近參知政事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sun Jin was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiashen: Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Sun Jin became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣大理寺丞薛倞、朱斐詣廣南路決滯獄。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Grand Court of Justice clerks Xue Chun and Zhu Fei were sent to Guangnan route to decide stalled cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Grand Court clerks Xue Chun and Zhu Fei were sent to Guangnan to clear stalled cases.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，王倫入見。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Wang Lun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Lun was received.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復以倫爲國信計議使，中書舍人蘇符副之，符辭以疾。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wang Lun was again made credentialed planning commissioner; Secretariat Drafter Su Fu was his deputy; Fu declined on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Lun was again made credentialed planning commissioner with Su Fu as deputy; Fu declined for illness.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以孫近兼權同知樞密院事

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Sun Jin was additionally made acting co-controller of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Sun Jin was additionally made acting co-controller of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔：「金國遣使入境，欲朕屈己就和，命侍從、台諫詳思條奏。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: an edict said: "The Jin state has sent envoys within our borders, wishing that We humble Ourselves and make peace; attendants and remonstrance officers are ordered to think deeply and memorialize in detail."
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, an edict said: "Jin envoys have entered our borders seeking Our humiliation for peace; attendants and remonstrance officers are to think hard and lay out their views."

sentences.zh: 」從官張燾、晏敦復、魏矼、曾開、李彌遜、尹焞、梁汝嘉、樓炤、蘇符、薛徽言、御史方廷實皆言不可。

translations.literal: Attendants Zhang Can, Yan Dunfu, Wei Hong, Zeng Kai, Li Miyuan, Yin Chun, Liang Rujia, Lou Zhao, Su Fu, Xue Huiyan, and investigating censor Fang Tingshi all said it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants Zhang Can, Yan Dunfu, Wei Hong, Zeng Kai, Li Miyuan, Yin Chun, Liang Rujia, Lou Zhao, Su Fu, Xue Huiyan, and censor Fang Tingshi all said no.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，王庶罷。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Wang Shu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wang Shu left office.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以樞密院編修官胡銓上書直諫，斥和議，除名、昭州編管。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: because Privy Council reviser Hu Quan memorialized in blunt remonstrance against the peace, he was stripped of name and assigned to Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Privy Council reviser Hu Quan bluntly attacked the peace in memorial; he was struck from the rolls and sent to Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子。

translations.literal: Day renzi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi.

sentences.zh: 改差監廣州都鹽倉。

translations.literal: His assignment was changed to superintendent of Guangzhou's capital salt depot.
translations.idiomatic: His post was changed to superintendent of Guangzhou's capital salt depot.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，以趙鼎爲醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin: Zhao Ding was made Liquan Abbey commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: Zhao Ding became Liquan Abbey commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以宗正少卿馮楫爲國信計議副使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Feng Ji was made deputy credentialed planning commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Imperial Clan Vice Director Feng Ji became deputy credentialed planning commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，以吏部尚書李光參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Personnel Minister Li Guang was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Personnel Minister Li Guang became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，王倫言金使稱「詔諭江南」，其名不正。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wang Lun said the Jin envoy called it "imperial instruction to pacify Jiangnan," and the name was not correct.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Lun said the Jin envoy spoke of "imperial instruction to pacify Jiangnan," and the title was wrong.

sentences.zh: 秦檜以未見國書，疑爲封冊。

translations.literal: Qin Hui, not having seen the state letter, suspected it was a patent of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui, not yet having seen the state letter, feared it was a patent of enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕嗣守祖宗基業，豈受金人封冊。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "We succeed and guard the ancestral foundation—how could We receive a patent of enfeoffment from Jin men?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "We guard the ancestral foundation—We will not take a Jin patent of enfeoffment."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，館職胡珵、朱松、張擴、淩景夏、常明、範如圭上書，極論不可和。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: academy officers Hu Cheng, Zhu Song, Zhang Kuo, Ling Jingxia, Chang Ming, and Fan Rugui memorialized, arguing at length that peace could not be made.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, academy officers Hu Cheng, Zhu Song, Zhang Kuo, Ling Jingxia, Chang Ming, and Fan Rugui memorialized that peace must not be made.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以端明殿學士韓肖胄簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Bright Hall Academician Han Xiaozhou was made signing Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Bright Hall Academician Han Xiaozhou was made signing Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命肖胄等爲金國奉表報謝使。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Xiaozhou and others were made Jin credentialed memorial and thanks envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xiaozhou and others were made credentialed memorial and thanks envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙子，張通古、蕭哲至行在，言先歸河南地，徐議餘事。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe reached the mobile court and said Henan lands would first be returned, with the rest discussed later.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Zhang Tonggu and Xiao Zhe reached court and said Henan would come back first, the rest later.

sentences.zh: 以監察御史施廷臣爲侍御史，權吏部尚書張燾、侍郎晏敦復以廷臣主和議而升用，執奏不行。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Shi Tingchen was made attendant censor; acting Personnel Minister Zhang Can and Vice Minister Yan Dunfu, because Tingchen favored the peace and was promoted, submitted memorials refusing to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Shi Tingchen became attendant censor; acting Personnel Minister Zhang Can and Vice Minister Yan Dunfu refused the appointment, saying Tingchen had risen for favoring peace.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞勾龍如淵、右諫議大夫李誼、殿中侍御史鄭剛中凡再至都堂，及宰執議取國書。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Gou Longruyuan, Right Remonstrance Officer Li Yi, and Palace Attendant Censor Zheng Gangzhong twice came to the chief councilors' hall to discuss taking the state letter.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Gou Longruyuan, Right Remonstrance Officer Li Yi, and Palace Censor Zheng Gangzhong twice came to the council hall to debate taking the state letter.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔：「金國使來，盡割河南、陝西故地，通好于我，許還梓宮及母兄親族，余無需索。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict said: "Jin envoys have come, ceding all former Henan and Shaanxi lands, making peace with Us, promising return of the coffin and the mother, brothers, and kin, with no further demands.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, an edict said: "Jin envoys have come, yielding all old Henan and Shaanxi, seeking peace with Us, promising the coffin and the mother, brothers, and kin, with nothing more asked.

sentences.zh: 令尚書省榜諭。

translations.literal: Let the Secretariat post notice."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Secretariat post notice."

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，帝不御殿。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 以方居諒陰，難行吉禮，命秦檜攝塚宰，受書以進。

translations.literal: Because he was in mourning, auspicious rites were hard to perform; Qin Hui was ordered to act as chief mourner and receive the letter to present.
translations.idiomatic: In mourning, auspicious rites could not be performed; Qin Hui was told to act as chief mourner, receive the letter, and present it.

sentences.zh: 是月，虛恨蠻犯嘉州忠鎮砦。

translations.literal: That month, the Xuhuan barbarians attacked Jia prefecture's Zhong stockade.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Xuhuan barbarians struck Jia's Zhong stockade.

sentences.zh: 是歲，始定都于杭。

translations.literal: That year, the capital was first fixed at Hang.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital was first fixed at Hang.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月壬午朔，帝在臨安。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, renwu new moon: the Emperor was at Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 9, spring, renwu new moon: Gaozong held court at Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以金國通和，大赦。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: because the Jin state had made peace, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, with Jin peace made, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 河南新復州軍官吏並不易置，蠲其民租稅三年，徭役五年。

translations.literal: Officials of newly recovered Henan prefectures and armies were all left unchanged; their people's rent and tax were remitted three years and corvée five years.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's newly recovered prefectures and armies kept their officials; rent and tax were forgiven three years, corvée five.

sentences.zh: 以王倫同簽書樞密院事，充奉護梓宮、迎請皇太后、交割地界使。

translations.literal: Wang Lun was made co-signing Privy Council affairs and credentialed commissioner to escort the coffin, welcome the empress dowager, and hand over territories.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lun was made co-signing Privy Council affairs and commissioner to escort the coffin, welcome the empress dowager, and deliver the borders.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣判大宗正事士㒟、兵部侍郎張燾詣河南修奉陵寢。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Yi and Military Affairs Vice Minister Zhang Can were sent to Henan to repair and tend the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Imperial Clan Vice Director Shi Yi and Military Affairs Vice Minister Zhang Can were sent to Henan to tend the tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜劉光世號和衆輔國功臣，張俊加少傅、安民靖難功臣，韓世忠爲少師，張浚復左宣奉大夫。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Liu Guangshi was given the title Merit Lord Who Harmonizes the Host; Zhang Jun was advanced to Junior Tutor and given the title Merit Lord Who Pacifies the People and Stills Disaster; Han Shizhong was made Junior Mentor; Zhang Jun was restored to Left Supporter of the Court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Guangshi took the title Harmonizing Host; Zhang Jun rose to Junior Tutor as Pacifying People; Han Shizhong became Junior Mentor; Zhang Jun was restored Left Supporter of the Court.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以尹焞爲徽猷閣待制、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀，焞力辭不拜。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Yin Chun was made Huixian Pavilion attendant-in-waiting and lecturer at the Wanshou Abbey, but Chun forcefully declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yin Chun was made Huixian attendant and Wanshou lecturer; Chun forcefully declined.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加岳飛、吳玠並開府儀同三司，楊沂中太尉。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Yue Fei and Wu Jie were both advanced to Grand Marshal with the ceremonial trappings of a chief minister's office; Yang Yizhong was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yue Fei and Wu Jie were both made Grand Marshal; Yang Yizhong became Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，建皇太后宮。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the empress dowager's palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the empress dowager's palace was built.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金宿州守臣趙榮來歸。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jin defender of Suzhou Zhao Rong came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Jin Suzhou defender Zhao Rong came over.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金主詔諭河南諸州以割地歸我之意。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Jin ruler issued an edict to Henan commanderies on the meaning of ceding land and returning it to Us.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Jin ruler edicted Henan commanderies on ceding land back to Song.

sentences.zh: 改發運經制司爲經制司，命戶部長貳一人領使，仍置副或判官。

translations.literal: The transport control commission was changed to the control commission; a chief Revenue Ministry officer was to head the commission, with still a deputy or controller.
translations.idiomatic: Transport control became control commission under a chief Revenue officer, with deputy or controller still set.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以王倫爲東京留守，郭仲荀爲副，戶部侍郎梁汝嘉兼江、淮、荊、浙、閩、廣路經制使，司農卿霍蠡爲判官。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Wang Lun was made Eastern Capital defender; Guo Zhongqi was his deputy; Revenue Vice Minister Liang Rujia was additionally made controller commissioner for Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, Fujian, and Guang routes; Court of Imperial Granaries Minister Huo Li was controller.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wang Lun became Eastern Capital defender with Guo Zhongqi deputy; Liang Rujia controlled Jiang-Huai-Jing-Zhe-Fujian-Guang; Huo Li was controller.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以吳玠爲四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wu Jie was made Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wu Jie became Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，以徽猷閣待制周聿爲陝西宣諭使，監察御史方廷實宣諭三京、淮北。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou: Huixian Pavilion attendant-in-waiting Zhou Yu was made Shaanxi credentialed commissioner; investigating censor Fang Tingshi was credentialed commissioner for the Three Capitals and north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guichou: Zhou Yu became Shaanxi credentialed commissioner; Fang Tingshi credentialed commissioner for the Three Capitals and Huai north.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以郭仲荀爲太尉、東京同留守。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Guo Zhongqi was made Grand Commandant and co-defender of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Guo Zhongqi became Grand Commandant and co-defender of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 慕洧寇環州。

translations.literal: Mu Wei raided Huan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Wei raided Huan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以知金州郭浩爲陝西宣撫判官。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Jin prefecture intendant Guo Hao was made Shaanxi pacification controller.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Guo Hao became Shaanxi pacification controller.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以李綱爲湖南路安撫大使，張浚知福州，尋復資政殿大學士，爲福建路安撫大使。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Li Gang was made Hunan pacification grand commissioner; Zhang Jun was made Fuzhou intendant; soon he was restored to Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and made Fujian pacification grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Li Gang became Hunan pacification grand commissioner; Zhang Jun Fuzhou intendant; soon he was restored Academician and made Fujian pacification grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命周聿、方廷實蒐訪隱士。

translations.literal: Zhou Yu and Fang Tingshi were ordered to seek out hidden scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Yu and Fang Tingshi were told to seek hidden scholars.

sentences.zh: 甲子，均定諸州縣月樁錢。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: monthly pile money of every prefecture and county was equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, monthly pile levies were equalized in every prefecture and county.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以郭浩爲陝西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Guo Hao was made Shaanxi credentialed commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Guo Hao became Shaanxi credentialed commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命修《徽宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day renshen: revision of the Veritable Records of Emperor Huizong was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, revision of Huizong's Veritable Records was ordered.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔盜賊已經招安而復嘯聚者，發兵加誅毋赦。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict said bandits already amnestied who again gathered in cry were to be struck by troops and put to death without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, bandits amnestied who rose again were to be struck and killed without pardon.

sentences.zh: 是月，日中有黑子，月餘乃沒。

translations.literal: That month, a black spot appeared in the sun and did not vanish for more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: That month a black spot sat on the sun for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 江西統制官李貴以其軍歸楊沂中。

translations.literal: Jiangxi controller Li Gui brought his army to Yang Yizhong.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi controller Li Gui brought his army to Yang Yizhong.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，以和州防禦使璩爲保大軍節度使，封崇國公。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: He prefecture defense commissioner Yu was made Baoda army military commissioner and enfeoffed Duke of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dinghai: He defender Yu became Baoda military commissioner and Duke of Chong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，王倫受地于金，得東西南三京、壽春、宿、亳、曹、單州及陝西、京西之地。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wang Lun received territory from the Jin, gaining the eastern, western, and southern capitals, Shouchun, Suzhou, Bozhou, Cao, and Dan prefectures and Shaanxi and Jingxi lands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Wang Lun took territory from the Jin: the three capitals, Shouchun, Suzhou, Bozhou, Cao, Dan, and Shaanxi and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 兀朮還祁州。

translations.literal: Wuzhu returned to Qi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu withdrew to Qi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，分河南爲三路，廢拱州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Henan was divided into three routes; Gong prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Henan was split into three routes and Gong prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以翰林學士樓炤簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Hanlin Academician Lou Zhao was made signing Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Hanlin Academician Lou Zhao was made signing Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，偽齊知開封府鄭億年上表待罪，召赴行在。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: puppet Qi's Kaifeng intendant Zheng Yinian submitted a memorial awaiting punishment and was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, puppet Qi's Kaifeng intendant Zheng Yinian submitted a guilt memorial and was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，正偽齊所改州縣名。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: names of prefectures and counties changed by puppet Qi were corrected.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, puppet Qi's renamed prefectures and counties were corrected.

sentences.zh: 是春，夏人陷府州。

translations.literal: That spring, the Xia took Fu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the Xia took Fu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，奉迎東京欽先、孝思殿累朝御容赴臨安。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: accumulated imperial portraits of successive reigns from the Eastern Capital's Qinxian and Xiaosi halls were escorted to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengyin: successive reigns' portraits from the Eastern Capital's Qinxian and Xiaosi halls were escorted to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復命江、淮守臣二年爲任。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Jiang and Huai defenders were again given two-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jiang and Huai defenders were again given two-year terms.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復置淮東提舉茶鹽司。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Huaidong tea-and-salt intendant commission was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Huaidong tea-and-salt intendant commission was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復召募耆長法。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the elder-chief recruitment law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the elder-chief recruitment law was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄜延副將李世輔部兵三千自鳳翔來歸，賜名顯忠。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Yan-Yan vice general Li Shipu led three thousand troops from Fengxiang to submit; he was given the name Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yan-Yan vice general Li Shipu brought three thousand from Fengxiang over; he was named Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，皇后邢氏崩于五國城。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: the empress, Lady Xing, died at the Five States Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengxu: Empress Xing died at the Five States Stockade.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，夏國主乾順卒。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Xia ruler Qian Shun died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xia ruler Qian Shun died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，樓炤以東京見卒四千四百人爲忠銳三將。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Lou Zhao, by commission, made the four thousand four hundred Eastern Capital troops the Loyal Sharp Three Commands.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lou Zhao by commission made four thousand four hundred Eastern Capital troops the Loyal Sharp Three Commands.

sentences.zh: 庚申，盜入邵武軍。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: bandits entered Shaowu army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, bandits entered Shaowu army.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以新復州縣官吏懷不自安，降詔開諭。

translations.literal: Day renxu: because officials of newly recovered prefectures and counties were uneasy in heart, an edict was sent to open and reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, with newly recovered officials uneasy, an edict reassured them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，吳玠薨。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Wu Jie died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Wu Jie died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，樓炤承制以李顯忠爲護國軍承宣使、樞密行府前軍都統制，率部兵及夏國招撫使王樞赴行在。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Lou Zhao, by commission, made Li Xianzhong Herald Who Guards the State, front-army overall controller of the Privy Council field office, and led his division and Xia credentialed recruitment commissioner Wang Shu to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Lou Zhao by commission made Li Xianzhong Herald Who Guards the State and front-army controller; he led his division and Xia recruiter Wang Shu to court.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，澧州軍事推官韓紃坐上書論講和非計，送循州編管。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Li prefecture military push-officer Han Hong was sentenced for memorializing that peace talks were no strategy and was sent to Xunzhou for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Li military push-officer Han Hong, for attacking the peace as no strategy, was sent to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以孟庾兼東京留守。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Meng Geng was additionally made co-defender of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Meng Geng was additionally made co-defender of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 王倫自東京赴金國議事。

translations.literal: Wang Lun went from the Eastern Capital to the Jin state to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lun went from the Eastern Capital to the Jin to discuss affairs.

sentences.zh: 樓炤承制以楊政爲熙河經略使，吳璘爲秦鳳經略使，仍並聽四川宣撫司節制；

translations.literal: Lou Zhao, by commission, made Yang Zheng Xihe route military commissioner and Wu Lin Qin-Feng route military commissioner, both still under the Sichuan pacification commission's command;
translations.idiomatic: Lou Zhao by commission made Yang Zheng Xihe commissioner and Wu Lin Qin-Feng commissioner, both still under Sichuan pacification;

sentences.zh: 郭浩爲鄜延經略使、同節制陝西軍馬。

translations.literal: Guo Hao was made Yan-Yan military commissioner with concurrent command of Shaanxi armies.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao became Yan-Yan commissioner with concurrent command of Shaanxi armies.

sentences.zh: 丙子，分宣撫司兵四萬人出屯熙、秦，六千人隸郭浩，留吳玠精兵二萬人屯興元府、興、洋二州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: forty thousand pacification troops were sent out to camp at Xi and Qin; six thousand were assigned to Guo Hao; Wu Jie's picked troops of twenty thousand camped at Xingyuan superior prefecture and Xing and Yang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, forty thousand pacification troops camped at Xi and Qin; six thousand went to Guo Hao; twenty thousand of Wu Jie's picked men camped at Xingyuan, Xing, and Yang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，置錢引務于永興軍。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the paper-money bureau was set at Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the paper-money bureau was set at Yongxing army.

sentences.zh: 是月，撫州鈐轄伍俊謀據桃源復叛，湖北安撫薛弼召誅之。

translations.literal: That month, Fuzhou controller Wu Jun plotted to hold Taoyuan and rebel again; Hubei pacification commissioner Xue Bi summoned and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fuzhou controller Wu Jun plotted to hold Taoyuan and rise again; Hubei pacification Xue Bi summoned and killed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，以文臣爲新復諸縣令。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiashen: civil officials were made magistrates of newly recovered counties.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiashen: civil officials were made magistrates of newly recovered counties.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，東京耆老李茂松、寇璋等二百人奉表稱賀，皆引見，補官遣還。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Eastern Capital elders Li Maosong, Kou Zhang, and two hundred others presented a congratulatory memorial; all were received in audience, given office, and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, two hundred Eastern Capital elders led by Li Maosong and Kou Zhang congratulated the throne, were received, given office, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 復置都水南、北丞各一員。

translations.literal: The southern and northern director posts of the Directorate of Waterways were each restored to one man.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Waterways southern and northern director posts were each restored to one man.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金人拘王倫于中山。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Jin men detained Wang Lun at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Jin detained Wang Lun at Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命詳驗劉豫偽官，換給告身。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Liu Yu's puppet officials were ordered examined in detail and given replacement patents of office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Yu's puppet officials were examined and given new patents.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，給還偽齊所沒民間資產。

translations.literal: Day yisi: assets seized from the people by puppet Qi were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, property seized by puppet Qi was returned to the people.

sentences.zh: 以胡世將兼權主管四川宣撫司。

translations.literal: Hu Shijiang was additionally made acting supervisor of the Sichuan pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shijiang was additionally made acting supervisor of Sichuan pacification.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，復淮南諸州學官。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: school officers of Huainan commanderies were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou: Huainan school officers were restored.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜陝西諸軍冬衣，絹十五萬匹。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Shaanxi armies were given winter clothing, one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Shaanxi armies were given winter clothing: one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 命前川、陝宣撫司便宜所補官，限一年自陳，換給告身。

translations.literal: Offices granted on expedient authority by the former Chuan-Shaan pacification commission were ordered to declare themselves within one year and receive replacement patents.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chuan-Shaan expedient appointments were told to declare within one year and receive new patents.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金國以撻懶主和割地，疑其二心，殺之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin state, because Tadalan had favored peace and the cession of land, suspected him of two minds and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Jin killed Tadalan, suspecting divided loyalty after he had backed peace and the land cession.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，蠲成都、潼川路歲輸對糴等米五十四萬石、水運錢七十九萬緡。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Chengdu and Tongchuan routes' yearly transport of paired-purchase grain and other rice of five hundred forty thousand shi and water-transport money of seven hundred ninety thousand strings was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Chengdu and Tongchuan yearly paired-purchase grain of five hundred forty thousand shi and water-transport money of seven hundred ninety thousand strings were cut.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，給新法度牒、紫衣師號錢二百萬緡付陝西市軍儲。

translations.literal: Day yichou: two million strings for new-law ordination certificates and purple-robe master titles were given to Shaanxi western-market army stores.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, two million strings for ordination certificates and purple-robe titles went to Shaanxi western-market army stores.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命陝西復行鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Shaanxi was ordered again to use iron coin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Shaanxi was told again to use iron coin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣蘇符等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Su Fu and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Su Fu and others were sent to the Jin for New Year congratulations.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣前知宿州趙榮、知壽州王威俱還金國。

translations.literal: Day yihai: former Suzhou intendant Zhao Rong and former Shou intendant Wang Wei were both sent back to the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, former Suzhou intendant Zhao Rong and former Shou intendant Wang Wei were both sent back to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 以關師古爲行營中護軍前軍統制。

translations.literal: Guan Shigu was made front-army controller of the Central Guard Army field camp.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Shigu became Central Guard front-army controller.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，命鄜延、秦鳳、熙河路招納蕃部熟戶及陷沒夏國軍民。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Yan-Yan, Qin-Feng, and Xihe routes were ordered to recruit settled tribal households and Xia troops and people who had fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jimao: Yan-Yan, Qin-Feng, and Xihe were told to recruit settled tribes and fallen Xia troops and people.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，封叔士㒟爲齊安郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Emperor's uncle Shi Yi was enfeoffed Prince of Qi'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Emperor's uncle Shi Yi was enfeoffed Prince of Qi'an.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷經制司，令提刑兼領常平事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the control commission was abolished; investigating censors were additionally to oversee the Ever-Normal Granary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the control commission was cut; investigating censors additionally oversaw the Ever-Normal Granary.

sentences.zh: 甲午，名皇太后殿曰慈寧。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the empress dowager's hall was named Cining.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the empress dowager's hall was named Cining.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以威州防禦使溫濟告韓世忠陰事勒停、南劍州編管

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Weizhou defense commissioner Wen Ji reported Han Shizhong's secret affairs; he was stripped and assigned to Jian prefecture
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Weizhou defender Wen Ji reported Han Shizhong's secret affairs; he was stripped and sent to Jian

translations.literal: (ii)
translations.idiomatic: [ii]

sentences.zh: 世忠又奏欲殺之，詔移萬安軍。

translations.literal: Shizhong again memorialized wishing to kill him; an edict moved him to Wan'an army.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong memorialized again asking to kill him; an edict moved him to Wan'an army.

sentences.zh: 己亥，郭仲荀率東京兵五千至鎮江。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Guo Zhongqi led five thousand Eastern Capital troops to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Guo Zhongqi led five thousand Eastern Capital troops to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，命續編《紹興因革禮》。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin: continuation of the Rites of Shaoxing Reforms was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: continuation of the Rites of Shaoxing Reforms was ordered.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李光罷。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Li Guang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Guang left office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命續修《元豐會要》。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: continuation of the Yuanfeng Administrative Compendium was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, continuation of the Yuanfeng Administrative Compendium was ordered.

sentences.zh: 兀朮留蘇符等于東京，謀復取河南。

translations.literal: Wuzhu detained Su Fu and others at the Eastern Capital and plotted to retake Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu detained Su Fu and others at the Eastern Capital and plotted to retake Henan.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丙戌，遣莫將等充迎護梓宮、奉迎兩宮使。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day bingxu: Mo Jiang and others were made commissioners to escort the coffin and welcome the Two Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 10, spring, bingxu: Mo Jiang and others were made commissioners to escort the coffin and welcome the Two Palaces.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李綱薨。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Gang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Gang died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以顯謨閣直學士、提舉醴泉觀鄭億年復資政殿學士，奉朝請。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xianmo Pavilion Direct Academician and Liquan Abbey lecturer Zheng Yinian was restored to Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and given court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xianmo Direct Academician and Liquan lecturer Zheng Yinian was restored Academician with court attendance.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，命陝西復募蕃漢弓箭手。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: Shaanxi was ordered again to recruit Fan and Han archers.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wushen: Shaanxi was told again to recruit Fan and Han archers.

sentences.zh: 詔贓吏罪抵死，情犯甚者，奏取旨。

translations.literal: An edict said corrupt officials whose crimes reached death, when the circumstances were especially grave, were to memorialize for the throne's decision.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said corrupt officials due death, when the case was especially grave, were to memorial for the throne's word.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 以劉錡爲東京副留守，李顯忠南京副留守。

translations.literal: Liu Qi was made co-defender of the Eastern Capital; Li Xianzhong was made co-defender of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi became co-defender of the Eastern Capital; Li Xianzhong co-defender of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命兩宗正官各舉所知宗室二人。

translations.literal: Day renzi: both directors of the Imperial Clan were ordered each to recommend two clansmen they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, both Imperial Clan directors were told each to name two clansmen they knew.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，展省試期一年。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the metropolitan examination period was extended one year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the metropolitan examination was put off one year.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔新復州軍蒐舉隱逸，諸路經理屯田。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered newly recovered prefectures and armies to seek hidden recluses; every route was to manage garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, newly recovered prefectures were told to seek hidden scholars; every route was to manage garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷史館，以日曆歸秘書省，置監修國史官。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the History Office was abolished; the calendar was placed under the Secretariat; a supervisor of national history revision was set.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the History Office was cut; the calendar went to the Secretariat; a supervisor of national history was set.

sentences.zh: 以孟庾知開封府，爲東京留守；

translations.literal: Meng Geng was made Kaifeng intendant and Eastern Capital defender;
translations.idiomatic: Meng Geng became Kaifeng intendant and Eastern Capital defender;

sentences.zh: 仇悆知河南府、西京留守。

translations.literal: Qiu Yue was made Henan intendant and Western Capital defender.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yue became Henan intendant and Western Capital defender.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷吏部審量宣和濫賞。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Personnel's review of Xuanhe-era excessive rewards was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Personnel's review of Xuanhe excessive rewards was cut.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，封閼伯爲商丘宣明王。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: Lord Quebo was enfeoffed King Xuanming of Shangqiu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiashen: Lord Quebo was enfeoffed King Xuanming of Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，增印錢引五百萬緡，付宣撫司市軍儲。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: printing of paper money was increased five million strings and given to the pacification commission to buy army stores.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, paper-money printing rose five million strings for the pacification commission to buy army stores.

sentences.zh: 川、陝宣撫副使胡世將屢言金人必渝盟，宜爲備。

translations.literal: Chuan-Shaan pacification Vice Commissioner Hu Shijiang repeatedly said the Jin would surely break the treaty and preparations should be made.
translations.idiomatic: Chuan-Shaan pacification Vice Commissioner Hu Shijiang said again and again the Jin would break treaty and the court should prepare.

sentences.zh: 己丑，罷諸路增置稅場。

translations.literal: Day jichou: added tax stations on every route were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, added tax stations on every route were cut.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠、張俊入見。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun were received.

sentences.zh: 始罷內教。

translations.literal: Inner instruction was first abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Inner instruction was first abolished.

sentences.zh: 復營建康行宮。

translations.literal: The Jiankang mobile palace was again built.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang mobile palace was built again.

sentences.zh: 丙申，蘇符自東京還。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Su Fu returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Su Fu returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命川、陝宣撫司軍事不及待報者，聽隨宜措置。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Chuan-Shaan pacification commission's military affairs that could not wait for report were permitted to be handled as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Chuan-Shaan military matters that could not wait for report were permitted expedient handling.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以郭浩知永興軍兼節制陝西諸路軍馬，楊政徙知興元府。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Guo Hao was made Yongxing army intendant with concurrent command of Shaanxi route armies; Yang Zheng was moved to be Xingyuan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Guo Hao became Yongxing intendant with command of Shaanxi armies; Yang Zheng was moved to Xingyuan intendant.

sentences.zh: 是月，命胡世將與夏人議入貢，夏人不報。

translations.literal: That month, Hu Shijiang was ordered to negotiate Xia tribute; the Xia did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hu Shijiang was told to negotiate Xia tribute; the Xia gave no answer.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，訪求亡逸曆書及精于星曆者。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingwu: lost calendrical books and experts in astronomy were sought.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingwu: the court sought lost calendars and skilled astronomers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以張中孚爲醴泉觀使，中彥提舉祐聖觀

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Zhang Zhongfu was made Liquan Abbey commissioner and Zhongyan superintendent of Yousheng Abbey
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Zhongfu became Liquan Abbey commissioner and Zhongyan superintendent of Yousheng Abbey

sentences.zh: ，趙彬爲兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: , and Zhao Bin was made War Minister.
translations.idiomatic: , and Zhao Bin became War Minister.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命部使者歲舉廉吏一人。

translations.literal: Day guihai: circuit envoys were ordered each year to recommend one incorrupt official.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, each circuit envoy was to recommend one honest official yearly.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復四川諸州學官。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Sichuan prefectural school officers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Sichuan prefectural school officers were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬申，韓肖胄罷。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Han Xiaozhou left office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Han Xiaozhou left office.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，金人叛盟，兀朮等分四道來攻。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: the Jin broke the treaty; Wuzhu and others attacked in four columns.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jimao: the Jin broke the treaty and Wuzhu struck in four columns.

sentences.zh: 甲申，名徽宗御制閣曰敷文。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Emperor's own writings hall was named Fuwen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor's writings hall was named Fuwen.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，兀朮入東京，留守孟庾以城降，知興仁府李師雄、知淮甯府李正民及河南諸州繼降。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wuzhu entered the Eastern Capital; garrison commander Meng Yu surrendered the city; Xingren prefect Li Shixiong, Huaining prefect Li Zhengmin, and Henan prefectures followed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wuzhu took the Eastern Capital; Meng Yu surrendered; Li Shixiong at Xingren, Li Zhengmin at Huaining, and Henan prefectures followed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，金人陷拱州，守臣王慥死之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Jin took Gong prefecture; defender Wang Gao died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Jin took Gong; defender Wang Gao died.

sentences.zh: 撒離曷自河中趨永興軍，陝西州縣官皆降。

translations.literal: Salihu marched from the center of the He to Yongxing army; Shaanxi prefectural and county officials all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Salihu marched from mid-He to Yongxing army, and Shaanxi officials all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金人陷南京，留守路允迪降。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Jin took the Southern Capital; garrison commander Lu Yundi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Jin took the Southern Capital; Lu Yundi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 劉錡引兵至順昌府。

translations.literal: Liu Qi led troops to Shunchang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi marched to Shunchang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，金人陷西京，留守李利用、副總管孫暉皆棄城走，鈐轄李興率兵拒戰，不克。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Jin took the Western Capital; garrison commander Li Liyong and deputy overall commander Sun Hui both abandoned the city and fled; controller Li Xing led troops to resist and could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Jin took the Western Capital; Li Liyong and deputy overall commander Sun Hui fled; controller Li Xing fought and failed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，胡世將自河池遣涇原經略使田晟以兵三千人迎敵金人。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Hu Shijiang sent Jingyuan circuit pacification commissioner Tian Sheng from Hechi with three thousand men to meet the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Hu Shijiang sent Jingyuan commissioner Tian Sheng from Hechi with three thousand to meet the Jin.

sentences.zh: 京、湖宣撫司忠義統領李寶敗金人于興仁府境上。

translations.literal: Jing-Hu pacification office loyalist commander Li Bao defeated the Jin on the border of Xingren prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jing-Hu loyalist commander Li Bao beat the Jin on Xingren's border.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，知亳州王彥先叛降于金。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Bozhou prefect Wang Yanxian first rebelled and surrendered to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Bozhou prefect Wang Yanxian rebelled and went over to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 金人陷永興軍，趨鳳翔。

translations.literal: The Jin took Yongxing army and pressed toward Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Yongxing army and pressed Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命胡世將移陝西之右護軍還屯蜀口。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Hu Shijiang was ordered to move the Right Guard Army of western Shaanxi back to camp at Shukou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hu Shijiang was told to pull the Right Guard Army of western Shaanxi back to Shukou.

sentences.zh: 以福建、廣東盜起，命兩路監司出境共討。

translations.literal: Because bandits rose in Fujian and Guangdong, the two circuits' surveillance commissioners were ordered to cross borders and suppress them jointly.
translations.idiomatic: With bandits in Fujian and Guangdong, both circuits' commissioners were told to cross borders and suppress them together.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命劉光世爲三京招撫處置使，以援劉錡。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Liu Guangshi was made pacification and disposition commissioner of the three capitals to aid Liu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liu Guangshi became pacification commissioner of the three capitals to aid Liu Qi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以吳璘同節制陝西諸路軍馬，聽胡世將便宜黜陟、處置軍事。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Wu Lin was made co-controller of Shaanxi military affairs, with Hu Shijiang empowered to dismiss and appoint and dispose of military affairs as needed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wu Lin co-controlled Shaanxi forces; Hu Shijiang could dismiss, appoint, and dispose of troops at need.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金人犯鳳翔府之石壁砦，吳璘遣統制姚仲等拒卻之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Jin attacked Shifeng stockade in Fengxiang prefecture; Wu Lin sent controllers Yao Zhong and others to beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Jin hit Shifeng stockade in Fengxiang; Wu Lin sent Yao Zhong and others and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 金人圍耀州，郭浩遣兵救之，金兵解去。

translations.literal: The Jin besieged Yao prefecture; Guo Hao sent troops to relieve it and the Jin withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Yao; Guo Hao relieved it and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金人圍順昌府，三路都統葛王褒以大軍繼至，劉錡力戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Jin besieged Shunchang; three-route overall commander Prince Ge Wangbao brought a great army in support; Liu Qi fought hard and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Jin besieged Shunchang; Prince Ge Wangbao brought a great army; Liu Qi fought hard and broke them.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，以韓世忠太保，張俊少師，岳飛少保，並兼河南、北諸路招討使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen new moon: Han Shizhong was made Grand Guardian, Zhang Jun Junior Mentor, and Yue Fei Junior Guardian; all were also made Henan north-and-south-route pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen new moon: Han Shizhong became Grand Guardian, Zhang Jun Junior Mentor, and Yue Fei Junior Guardian; all were also Henan north-and-south-route pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，劉錡遣將閻充

translations.literal: Day yisi: Liu Qi sent general Yan Chong
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Liu Qi sent general Yan Chong

sentences.zh: 戰敗金人于順昌之李村。

translations.literal: to defeat the Jin at Licun in Shunchang.
translations.idiomatic: to beat the Jin at Licun near Shunchang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命兩浙、江東、福建諸州團結弓弩手。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liang-Zhe, Jiangdong, and Fujian prefectures were ordered to muster crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Liang-Zhe, Jiangdong, and Fujian were told to muster crossbowmen.

sentences.zh: 以仇悆爲沿海制置使。

translations.literal: Qiu Yue was made coastal control commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yue became coastal control commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔將佐士卒能立奇功者，賞以使相節鉞官告，臨軍給受。

translations.literal: An edict said officers and soldiers who could win extraordinary merit would be rewarded with commissioner and military commissioner patents and field pay on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promised commissioner and military commissioner patents and field pay to officers and soldiers who won extraordinary merit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，罷建康府行宮營繕。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: construction at the Jiankang mobile-court palace was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Jiankang mobile-court construction was halted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以劉錡爲沿淮制置使

translations.literal: Day wushen: Liu Qi was made Huai-river coast control commissioner
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Liu Qi became Huai-river coast control commissioner

sentences.zh: 己酉，吳璘遣統制李師顏等戰敗金人于扶風，拔之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wu Lin sent controllers Li Shiyan and others to defeat the Jin at Fufeng and recover the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wu Lin sent Li Shiyan and others to beat the Jin at Fufeng and recover the city.

sentences.zh: 壬子，兀朮及宋叛將孔彥舟、酈瓊、趙榮等帥衆十余萬攻順昌府，劉錡率將士殊死戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wuzhu with Song defectors Kong Yanzhao, Li Qiong, and Zhao Rong and others led more than one hundred thousand to attack Shunchang; Liu Qi and his officers fought to the death and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wuzhu with defectors Kong Yanzhao, Li Qiong, Zhao Rong, and more than one hundred thousand struck Shunchang; Liu Qi and his men fought to the death and routed them.

sentences.zh: 初，秦檜奏命錡擇利班師，錡不奉詔，戰益力，遂能以寡勝衆。

translations.literal: Earlier Qin Hui had memorialized ordering Qi to withdraw when advantage allowed; Qi did not obey and fought harder, and so with few he overcame many.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Qin Hui had told Qi to withdraw when advantage allowed; Qi disobeyed, fought harder, and with few overcame many.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，順昌圍解，兀朮還。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Shunchang siege was lifted and Wuzhu withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Shunchang was relieved and Wuzhu withdrew.

sentences.zh: 以知平江府梁汝嘉兼浙西沿海制置使。

translations.literal: Pingjiang prefect Liang Rujia was made concurrent Zhexi coastal control commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang prefect Liang Rujia was also made Zhexi coastal control commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，岳飛將牛皋及金人戰于京西，敗之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Yue Fei's general Niu Gao fought the Jin in Jingxi and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Yue Fei's Niu Gao fought the Jin in Jingxi and won.

sentences.zh: 己未，劉光世進軍和州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Liu Guangshi advanced to He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Liu Guangshi advanced to He.

sentences.zh: 郭浩遣統制鄭建充攻破金人于醴州，復其城。

translations.literal: Guo Hao sent controller Zheng Jianchong to break the Jin at Li prefecture and recover the city.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao sent Zheng Jianchong to break the Jin at Li and recover the city.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔諸司錢物量留經費外，悉發以贍軍。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered every office, after setting aside operating funds, to send all remaining money to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, every office was told to send all money beyond operating costs to the army.

sentences.zh: 樓炤以父喪去位。

translations.literal: Lou Zhao left office on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Zhao left office for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 甲子，撒離曷攻青溪嶺，鄜延經略使王彥率兵戰敗之，撒離曷還屯鳳翔。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Salihu attacked Qingxi Ridge; Yan-Yan pacification commissioner Wang Yan led troops and defeated him; Salihu returned to camp at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Salihu attacked Qingxi Ridge; Wang Yan of Yan-Yan beat him back and Salihu returned to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 命士㒟主奉濮王祠事。

translations.literal: Shi Yi was ordered to preside at the Prince of Pu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yi was told to preside at the Prince of Pu's temple.

sentences.zh: 張俊遣左護軍都統制王德援劉錡，德暫至順昌，值圍已解，復還廬州。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun sent Left Guard Army overall controller Wang De to aid Liu Qi; De reached Shunchang briefly, but the siege was already lifted, and he returned to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun sent Wang De to aid Liu Qi; De reached Shunchang briefly, found the siege lifted, and returned to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 遣司農少卿李若虛詣岳飛軍諭指班師，飛不聽。

translations.literal: Supervisor of Agriculture Vice Minister Li Ruoxu was sent to Yue Fei's army to convey orders to withdraw; Fei would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Agriculture Vice Minister Li Ruoxu was sent to Yue Fei to order withdrawal; Fei refused.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，下詔撫諭順昌府官吏兵民。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict comforted Shunchang officials, soldiers, and people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, an edict comforted Shunchang officials, soldiers, and people.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以劉錡爲武泰軍節度使、侍衛馬軍都虞候。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Liu Qi was made military commissioner of Wutai army and vice commander of the Palace Horse Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Liu Qi took Wutai army and became vice commander of the Palace Horse Army.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠遣統制王勝、背嵬將成閔率兵至淮陽軍南，與金人遇，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong sent controllers Wang Sheng and Back-the-Mountain general Cheng Min with troops south of Huaiyang army, met the Jin, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong sent Wang Sheng and Back-the-Mountain general Cheng Min south of Huaiyang, met the Jin, and beat them.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人圍慶陽府，權守臣宋萬年固守，金人不能下。

translations.literal: That month the Jin besieged Qingyang prefecture; acting defender Song Wannian held firm and the Jin could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin besieged Qingyang; acting defender Song Wannian held and they could not take it.

sentences.zh: 岳飛領兵援劉錡，與金人戰于蔡州，敗之，復蔡州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei led troops to aid Liu Qi, fought the Jin at Cai prefecture, defeated them, and recovered Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei aided Liu Qi, fought the Jin at Cai, won, and recovered Cai.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉朔，張俊遣統制宋超敗金人于永城縣朱家村。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guiyou new moon: Zhang Jun sent controller Song Chao and defeated the Jin at Zhujia village in Yongcheng county.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guiyou new moon: Zhang Jun's Song Chao beat the Jin at Zhujia village in Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，追孟庾、路允迪官，徙家屬遠郡。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Meng Yu and Lu Yundi were stripped of office; their families were moved to distant prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Meng Yu and Lu Yundi were stripped of office and their families sent to distant prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔三衙管軍及觀察使已上，各舉智略勇猛、材堪將帥者二人。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict ordered the three palace guard commanders and observation commissioners and above each to recommend two men of strategy, courage, and generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, three palace guard commanders and observation commissioners and above were each to recommend two able generals.

sentences.zh: 金人犯涇州，守臣曲汲棄城去，經略使田晟率兵來救，金人敗走。

translations.literal: The Jin attacked Jing prefecture; defender Qu Ji abandoned the city; pacification commissioner Tian Sheng came to relieve and the Jin fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin hit Jing; Qu Ji abandoned the city; Tian Sheng relieved it and they fled.

sentences.zh: 甲申，晟及金人再戰于涇州，敗之，金人引歸鳳翔。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Tian Sheng again fought the Jin at Jing and defeated them; the Jin withdrew toward Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Tian Sheng again beat the Jin at Jing and they withdrew toward Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，降陝西雜犯死罪，釋流以下囚。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: miscellaneous capital crimes in Shaanxi were reduced from death; prisoners below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Shaanxi capital crimes below death were eased and exiles and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以胡世將爲端明殿學士，吳璘爲鎮西節度使，楊政武當節度使，郭浩奉國節度使。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Hu Shijiang was made Manifest Brightness Hall academician; Wu Lin military commissioner of Zhenxi; Yang Zheng of Wudang; Guo Hao of Fengguo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hu Shijiang became Manifest Brightness Hall academician; Wu Lin took Zhenxi; Yang Zheng Wudang; Guo Hao Fengguo.

sentences.zh: 王德攻金人于宿州，夜破之，降其守馬秦。

translations.literal: Wang De attacked the Jin at Suzhou, broke them at night, and their defender Ma Qin surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De struck Suzhou at night, broke the Jin, and defender Ma Qin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔釋順昌府流以下囚，再復租稅二年，守禦官吏進官一等。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict released Shunchang prisoners below exile, remitted taxes two years again, and advanced defending officials one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Shunchang prisoners below exile were freed, taxes remitted two more years, and defenders advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 己丑，永興軍鈐轄傅忠信等與金人戰于華陰縣，敗之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Yongxing army controller Fu Zhongxin and others fought the Jin at Huayin county and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yongxing controller Fu Zhongxin and others beat the Jin at Huayin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，岳飛遣統制張憲擊金將韓常于潁昌府，敗之，復潁昌。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Yue Fei sent controller Zhang Xian to strike Jin general Han Chang at Yingchang and defeated him; Yingchang was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yue Fei's Zhang Xian struck Han Chang at Yingchang, won, and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 丙申，張憲復淮寧府。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Zhang Xian recovered Huaining prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhang Xian recovered Huaining.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，趙鼎分司、興化軍居住。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Zhao Ding was made division official and lived at Xinghua army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhao Ding became a division official at Xinghua army.

sentences.zh: 岳飛遣統制郝晸等與金人戰于鄭州北，復鄭州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei sent controller Hao Zheng and others to fight the Jin north of Zheng prefecture, defeated them, and recovered Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei's Hao Zheng fought the Jin north of Zheng, won, and recovered Zheng.

sentences.zh: 李興復汝州，與金人戰于河清縣，敗之，復伊陽等八縣，李成遁去。

translations.literal: Li Xing recovered Ru prefecture, fought the Jin at Heqing county, defeated them, recovered eight counties including Yiyang, and Li Cheng fled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xing recovered Ru, beat the Jin at Heqing, took back eight counties including Yiyang, and Li Cheng fled.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠遣統制王勝、王權攻海州，克之，執其守王山。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong sent controllers Wang Sheng and Wang Quan to attack Haizhou, took it, and seized defender Wang Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong sent Wang Sheng and Wang Quan to take Haizhou and seized defender Wang Shan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，張俊率統制宋超

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Zhang Jun led controllers Song Chao
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhang Jun led controllers Song Chao

sentences.zh: 等及王德兵會于城父縣，酈瓊及葛王褒遁去，遂復亳州。

translations.literal: and others; Wang De's troops joined at Chengfu county; Li Qiong and Prince Ge Wangbao fled, and Bozhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: and others; Wang De joined at Chengfu; Li Qiong and Prince Ge Wangbao fled, and Bozhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 己亥，金人救海州，王權等逆戰，敗之，復懷仁縣。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Jin relieved Haizhou; Wang Quan and others met them in battle and defeated them; Huairen county was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Jin relieved Haizhou; Wang Quan met them, won, and Huairen was recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張俊棄亳州，引軍還壽春。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhang Jun abandoned Bozhou and led the army back to Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Jun abandoned Bozhou and fell back to Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 再貶趙鼎漳州居住，又貶清遠軍節度副使、潮州安置。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding was demoted again to live at Zhangzhou, then to Qingyuan army deputy military commissioner at Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding was demoted again to Zhangzhou, then to Qingyuan deputy military commissioner at Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，岳飛遣將張應、韓清入西京，會李興復永安軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guimao: Yue Fei sent generals Zhang Ying and Han Qing into the Western Capital; they joined Li Xing to recover Yong'an army.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guimao: Yue Fei sent Zhang Ying and Han Qing into the Western Capital; with Li Xing they recovered Yong'an army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以御史中丞王次翁參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Investigating Censor-in-Chief Wang Ciweng was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Investigating Censor-in-Chief Wang Ciweng became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，岳飛及兀朮戰于郾城縣，敗之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Yue Fei fought Wuzhu at Yancheng county and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yue Fei fought Wuzhu at Yancheng and won.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，曲赦海州。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Haizhou received a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Haizhou received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 永興軍統領辛鎮及金人戰于長安城下，敗之。

translations.literal: Yongxing army commander Xin Zhen fought the Jin below Chang'an city and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing commander Xin Zhen fought the Jin below Chang'an and won.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以楊沂中爲淮北宣撫副使，劉錡爲判官。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Yang Yizhong was made Huai north pacification vice commissioner and Liu Qi his judge.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yang Yizhong became Huai north pacification vice commissioner with Liu Qi as judge.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，岳飛遣統制楊再興、王蘭等擊金人于小商橋，皆戰死。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yue Fei sent controllers Yang Zaixing and Wang Lan to strike the Jin at Xiaoshang Bridge; all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yue Fei sent Yang Zaixing and Wang Lan against the Jin at Xiaoshang Bridge; all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，金人攻潁昌，岳飛遣將王貴、姚政合兵力戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Jin attacked Yingchang; Yue Fei sent generals Wang Gui and Yao Zheng; together they fought hard and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Jin hit Yingchang; Wang Gui and Yao Zheng fought hard under Yue Fei and won.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，飛以累奉詔班師，遂自郾城還，軍皆潰，金人追之不及。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Fei, having repeatedly received orders to withdraw, then left Yancheng; the army broke up in flight and the Jin could not overtake them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, after repeated orders to withdraw, Fei left Yancheng; the army scattered and the Jin could not catch them.

sentences.zh: 潁昌、蔡、鄭諸州皆復爲金有。

translations.literal: Yingchang, Cai, Zheng, and other prefectures all fell back to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang, Cai, Zheng, and other prefectures all returned to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以釋奠文宣王爲大祀。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: sacrifice to Confucius was raised to a great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, sacrifice to Confucius became a great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，增收州縣頭子錢爲激賞費。

translations.literal: Day yichou: prefectural and county touzi money was increased as reward funds.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, prefectural touzi money was raised for reward funds.

sentences.zh: 金人圍淮甯府，趙秉淵棄城南歸。

translations.literal: The Jin besieged Huaining prefecture; Zhao Bingyuan abandoned the city and returned south.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Huaining; Zhao Bingyuan abandoned the city and returned south.

sentences.zh: 辛未，金人犯盭厔縣，王俊逆戰于東洛穀，卻之。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the Jin attacked Lizhi county; Wang Jun met them in battle at Dongluo valley and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Jin hit Lizhi; Wang Jun met them at Dongluo valley and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔，以張九成、喻樗、陳剛中、淩景夏、樊光遠、毛叔度、元盥等七人嘗不主和議，皆降黜之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen new moon: Zhang Jiucheng, Yu Chu, Chen Gangzhong, Ling Jingxia, Fan Guangyuan, Mao Shudu, Yuan Guan, and seven others who had opposed peace were all demoted and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renshen new moon: Zhang Jiucheng, Yu Chu, Chen Gangzhong, Ling Jingxia, Fan Guangyuan, Mao Shudu, Yuan Guan, and seven others who had opposed peace were demoted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，韓世忠圍淮陽軍，不克。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Han Shizhong besieged Huaiyang army but could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Han Shizhong besieged Huaiyang but could not take it.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金人及酈瓊合兵駐于千秋湖陵，韓世忠遣統制劉寶等夜襲破之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Jin and Li Qiong combined and camped at Qianqiu Lake mound; Han Shizhong sent controller Liu Bao and others to raid them at night and break them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Jin and Li Qiong camped at Qianqiu Lake; Han Shizhong's Liu Bao raided at night and broke them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，李成犯西京，李興擊卻之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Li Cheng attacked the Western Capital; Li Xing drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Li Cheng attacked the Western Capital; Li Xing drove him back.

sentences.zh: 楊沂中軍于宿州。

translations.literal: Yang Yizhong's army was at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong camped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以郭浩知夔州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Guo Hao was made prefect of Kui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Guo Hao became prefect of Kui.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，楊沂中自宿州夜襲柳子鎮，軍潰，遂自壽春府渡淮歸，金人屠宿州。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Yang Yizhong raided Liuzi town from Suzhou at night; the army collapsed; he then crossed the Huai from Shouchun and returned, and the Jin slaughtered Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Yang Yizhong raided Liuzi from Suzhou at night, his army collapsed, he crossed the Huai from Shouchun, and the Jin slaughtered Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，川、陝宣撫司統領王喜等遇金人于汧陽縣，敗之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office commander Wang Xi and others met the Jin at Qianyang county and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Sichuan-Shaanxi commander Wang Xi and others met the Jin at Qianyang and won.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅朔，遣起居舍人李易諭韓世忠罷兵。
