translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin new moon: Attendant Gentleman Li Yi was sent to tell Han Shizhong to cease fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin new moon: Attendant Gentleman Li Yi was sent to tell Han Shizhong to stop fighting.

sentences.zh: 時秦檜專主和議，諸大帥皆還鎮。

translations.literal: At this time Qin Hui monopolized the peace policy and the great commanders all returned to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui then monopolized peace and the great commanders all returned to their posts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，楊政遣統制楊從儀夜襲金人于鳳翔府，敗之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Yang Zheng sent controller Yang Congyi to raid the Jin at Fengxiang at night and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yang Zheng's Yang Congyi raided the Jin at Fengxiang by night and won.

sentences.zh: 戊申，金人復入西京，李興棄城去。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Jin re-entered the Western Capital; Li Xing abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Jin re-entered the Western Capital; Li Xing abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，合祀天地于明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed together at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Bright Hall and there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，臨安火。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Lin'an caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Lin'an burned.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以郭浩知金州，節制陝西、河東軍馬兼措置河東忠義軍。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Guo Hao was made prefect of Jin prefecture and controlled Shaanxi and Hedong forces while also arranging Hedong loyalist troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Guo Hao took Jin, controlled Shaanxi and Hedong forces, and arranged Hedong loyalists.

sentences.zh: 是秋，知代州王忠植舉兵復石、代等十一州。

translations.literal: That autumn, Dai prefecture prefect Wang Zhongzhi raised troops and recovered eleven prefectures including Shi and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Dai prefect Wang Zhongzhi raised troops and recovered eleven prefectures including Shi and Dai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，復張浚觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou: Zhang Jun's Observatory academician title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiyou: Zhang Jun's Observatory academician title was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以王忠植爲建甯軍承宣使、河東路經略安撫使。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Wang Zhongzhi was made Jianning army commissioner and Hedong-route pacification and soothing commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wang Zhongzhi became Jianning commissioner and Hedong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，秦檜上《重修紹興在京通用敕令格式》。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Qin Hui presented the Revised Shaoxing Capital General Statutes and Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Qin Hui presented the Revised Shaoxing Capital General Statutes and Regulations.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金人犯慶陽府，守臣宋萬年以城降。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Jin attacked Qingyang prefecture; defender Song Wannian surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Jin attacked Qingyang; Song Wannian surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金人犯陝州，吳琦率兵迎擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Jin attacked Shan prefecture; Wu Qi led troops to meet them and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Jin hit Shan; Wu Qi met them and won.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金人襲洮州，攻鐵城堡，統制孔文清、惠逢擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Jin raided Tao prefecture and attacked Tiecheng stockade; controllers Kong Wenqing and Hui Feng defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Jin raided Tao and hit Tiecheng; Kong Wenqing and Hui Feng beat them back.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉錡入見。

translations.literal: That month Liu Qi had audience.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Qi was received at court.

sentences.zh: 胡世將命王忠植救慶陽，叛將趙惟清執之降于金，忠植不屈而死。

translations.literal: Hu Shijiang ordered Wang Zhongzhi to relieve Qingyang; rebel Zhao Weiqing seized him and surrendered him to the Jin; Zhongzhi refused submission and died.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shijiang sent Wang Zhongzhi to relieve Qingyang; rebel Zhao Weiqing seized him for the Jin; Zhongzhi would not submit and died.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，金將合喜復犯陝州，吳琦擊卻之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: Jin general Hexi again attacked Shan prefecture; Wu Qi drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingwei: Jin general Hexi again hit Shan; Wu Qi drove him back.

sentences.zh: 又犯寶溪縣，統制楊從儀敗之。

translations.literal: They again attacked Baoxi county; controller Yang Congyi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: They again hit Baoxi; Yang Congyi defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以令爲保甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Ling was made military commissioner of Baoning army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Ling became Baoning military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，宜章洞民駱科叛，犯桂陽、郴、道、連、賀諸州，命發大兵討之。

translations.literal: That month Yizhang cave people under Luo Ke rebelled and attacked Guiyang, Chen, Dao, Lian, and He prefectures; a great army was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luo Ke of Yizhang cave rebelled and struck Guiyang, Chen, Dao, Lian, and He; a great army was ordered against him.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，上皇太后冊寶于慈寧殿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: the Empress Dowager's seals and regalia were presented at Cining Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renwu: the Empress Dowager's seals and regalia were presented at Cining Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，贈王忠植奉國軍節度使，諡義節。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wang Zhongzhi was posthumously made Fengguo military commissioner with the posthumous title Yijie.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Zhongzhi was posthumously made Fengguo commissioner with the posthumous title Yijie.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，起諸路耆長役錢隸總制司，專給軍用。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: elders' corvée money on every route was levied to the overall control office for military use alone.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, elders' corvée money on every route went to the overall control office for the army alone.

sentences.zh: 是月，楊沂中引兵還行在。

translations.literal: That month Yang Yizhong led troops back to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yang Yizhong brought his troops back to court.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月癸卯，鳳翔統制楊從儀敗金人于渭南。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, day guimao: Fengxiang controller Yang Congyi defeated the Jin at Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, first month, guimao: Fengxiang controller Yang Congyi beat the Jin at Weinan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張俊入見

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Jun had audience
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Jun was received

sentences.zh: 乙卯，金人犯壽春府，守臣孫暉、統制雷仲合兵拒之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Jin attacked Shouchun prefecture; defender Sun Hui and controller Lei Zhong combined forces to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Jin attacked Shouchun; Sun Hui and Lei Zhong combined to resist.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，壽春陷，暉、仲棄城去。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Shouchun fell; Hui and Zhong abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Shouchun fell; Hui and Zhong abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 己未，劉錡自太平州率兵二萬援淮西。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Liu Qi led twenty thousand troops from Taiping prefecture to aid Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Liu Qi led twenty thousand from Taiping to aid Huai west.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金人渡淮。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Jin crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Jin crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，劉錡至廬州還。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Liu Qi reached Luzhou and turned back.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liu Qi reached Luzhou and turned back.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，兀朮陷廬州。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Wuzhu took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wuzhu took Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金人陷商州，守臣邵隆棄城去。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Jin took Shang prefecture; defender Shao Long abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Jin took Shang; Shao Long abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命楊沂中引兵赴淮西，岳飛進兵江州。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Yang Yizhong was ordered to lead troops to Huai west and Yue Fei to advance to Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yang Yizhong was told to Huai west and Yue Fei to advance to Jiang.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，張俊遣王德渡江，屯和州，金人退屯昭關。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: Zhang Jun sent Wang De across the river to camp at He prefecture; the Jin withdrew to Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guiyou: Zhang Jun sent Wang De across the river to He; the Jin fell back to Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 邵隆破金人于洪門，復商州

translations.literal: Shao Long defeated the Jin at Hongmen and recovered Shang prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Shao Long beat the Jin at Hongmen and recovered Shang

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金人復來爭和州，張俊敗之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Jin came again to contest He prefecture; Zhang Jun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Jin returned to contest He; Zhang Jun defeated them.

sentences.zh: 命韓世忠以兵援淮西。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong was ordered to send troops to aid Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong was told to send troops to Huai west.

sentences.zh: 丙子，趣岳飛會兵蘄、黃。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yue Fei was urged to concentrate forces at Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yue Fei was urged to concentrate at Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 王德等敗金人于含山縣東。

translations.literal: Wang De and others defeated the Jin east of Hanshan county.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De and others beat the Jin east of Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，統制關師古、李橫擊敗金人于巢縣，復之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: controllers Guan Shigu and Li Heng defeated the Jin at Chao county and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Guan Shigu and Li Heng beat the Jin at Chao and recovered the county.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，岳飛發鄂州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Yue Fei set out from Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yue Fei set out from Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，知泰州王㬇兼通、泰二州制置使。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Taizhou prefect Wang Huan was made concurrent Tong-Tai two-prefecture control commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Taizhou prefect Wang Huan was also made Tong-Tai control commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，王德、田師中等擊破金人，復含山縣，奪昭關。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Wang De, Tian Shizhong, and others broke the Jin, recovered Hanshan county, and seized Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Wang De, Tian Shizhong, and others broke the Jin, recovered Hanshan, and took Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 劉錡自東關擊敗金人于青谿。

translations.literal: Liu Qi from Dong Pass defeated the Jin at Qingxi.
translations.idiomatic: From Dong Pass Liu Qi beat the Jin at Qingxi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，金人復犯昭關，王德等又敗之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Jin again attacked Zhaoguan; Wang De and others defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Jin again hit Zhaoguan; Wang De and others beat them again.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠遣統領崔皋

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong sent commander Cui Gao
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong sent commander Cui Gao

sentences.zh: 擊敗金人于舒城縣。

translations.literal: to defeat the Jin at Shucheng county.
translations.idiomatic: to beat the Jin at Shucheng.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，楊沂中、劉錡等大敗兀朮軍于柘皋。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Yang Yizhong, Liu Qi, and others heavily defeated Wuzhu's army at Zhegao.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Yang Yizhong, Liu Qi, and others routed Wuzhu at Zhegao.

sentences.zh: 己丑，兀朮親率兵逆戰于店步，沂中等又敗之，乘勝逐北，遂復廬州。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Wuzhu personally led troops to meet them in battle at Dianbu; Yizhong and the others defeated them again; pressing the victory northward, they recovered Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wuzhu met them at Dianbu; Yizhong and the others won again, pressed north, and recovered Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，虔、吉州盜賊悉平。

translations.literal: That month Qian and Ji prefecture bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qian and Ji bandits were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子朔，張浚

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi new moon: Zhang Jun
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengzi new moon: Zhang Jun

translations.literal: Editorial bracket (opening).
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket (opening).

sentences.zh: 進鬻田及賣度牒錢六十三萬緡助軍用。

translations.literal: advanced six hundred thirty thousand strings from selling fields and ordination certificates to aid military funds.
translations.idiomatic: advanced six hundred thirty thousand strings from selling fields and ordination certificates for the army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，韓世忠引兵趨壽春。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Han Shizhong led troops toward Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Han Shizhong marched toward Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，復張浚特進

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhang Jun's special advancement
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Jun's special advancement

translations.literal: Editorial bracket (opening).
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket (opening).

sentences.zh: （一一）〉
金人圍濠州。

translations.literal: The Jin besieged Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 岳飛發舒州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei set out from Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei set out from Shu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，張俊、楊沂中、劉錡議班師。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zhang Jun, Yang Yizhong, and Liu Qi discussed withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhang Jun, Yang Yizhong, and Liu Qi agreed to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，沂中、錡先行，俊以輕兵留後。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Yizhong and Qi went first; Jun kept light troops in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yizhong and Qi went first; Jun kept light troops behind.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔釋淮西雜犯死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict released Huai west miscellaneous capital prisoners below death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Huai west capital prisoners below death were released.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金人陷濠州，執守臣王進，夷其城，鈐轄邵青死之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Jin took Haozhou, seized defender Wang Jin, leveled the city, and controller Shao Qing died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Jin took Haozhou, seized Wang Jin, leveled the city, and Shao Qing died fighting.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張俊遣楊沂中、王德入濠州，遇金伏兵，敗還。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong and Wang De into Haozhou, met Jin ambush, and retreated defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong and Wang De into Haozhou, met an ambush, and fell back beaten.

sentences.zh: 己酉，韓世忠至濠州，不利而退。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Han Shizhong reached Haozhou, found conditions unfavorable, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Han Shizhong reached Haozhou, found no advantage, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，岳飛次定遠縣，聞金兵退，還屯舒州。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Yue Fei halted at Dingyuan county; hearing the Jin had withdrawn, he returned to camp at Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Yue Fei halted at Dingyuan; hearing the Jin had withdrawn, he returned to Shu.

sentences.zh: 楊沂中歸行在。

translations.literal: Yang Yizhong returned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong returned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬子，金人渡淮北歸。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Jin crossed north of the Huai and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Jin crossed north of the Huai and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，張俊歸建康府

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhang Jun returned to Jiankang prefecture
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhang Jun returned to Jiankang

translations.literal: Editorial bracket (opening).
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket (opening).

sentences.zh: （一二）〉
丁巳，劉錡歸太平州。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Liu Qi returned to Taiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liu Qi returned to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，行營統制張彥及金人遇于汧陽之劉坊砦，第八將張宏戰沒。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: field-camp controller Zhang Yan met the Jin at Liufang stockade in Qianyang; Eighth Company Zhang Hong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, field-camp controller Zhang Yan met the Jin at Liufang in Qianyang; Zhang Hong of the Eighth Company died fighting.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，復收免行錢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingzi: the exemption travel-money levy was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingzi: the exemption travel-money levy was restored.

sentences.zh: 己卯，孫近罷。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Sun Jin left office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Sun Jin left office.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以王次翁兼權同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Wang Ciweng was made acting concurrent Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wang Ciweng was made acting concurrent Privy Council vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠、張俊、岳飛相繼入覲

translations.literal: Han Shizhong, Zhang Jun, and Yue Fei in succession had audience
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong, Zhang Jun, and Yue Fei were received in turn

translations.literal: Editorial bracket (opening).
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket (opening).

sentences.zh: （一三）〉
壬辰，以世忠、俊並爲樞密使，飛樞密副使，命三省、樞密院官復分班奏事。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Shizhong and Jun were both made Privy Council commissioners and Fei Privy Council vice commissioner; the Three Departments and Privy Council were ordered to resume separate shifts for memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Shizhong and Jun became Privy Council commissioners and Fei vice commissioner; the Three Departments and Privy Council resumed separate memorial shifts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，張俊請以所部兵隸御前

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Zhang Jun requested that his troops be placed under the Imperial Front
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhang Jun asked that his troops join the Imperial Front

translations.literal: Editorial bracket (opening).
translations.idiomatic: Editorial bracket (opening).

sentences.zh: （一四）〉
罷三宣撫司，改統制官爲御前統制官，各屯駐舊所。

translations.literal: The three pacification offices were abolished; control officers were changed to Imperial Front control officers, each garrisoned at their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: The three pacification offices were abolished; control officers became Imperial Front control officers at their old posts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以廣西經略使胡舜陟節制廣東、湖南兵，趣討駱科。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Guangxi pacification commissioner Hu Shunzhi controlled Guangdong and Hunan troops and was urged to suppress Luo Ke.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Guangxi commissioner Hu Shunzhi took Guangdong and Hunan troops and was urged against Luo Ke.

sentences.zh: 慕容洧破新泉砦，又攻會州，將官朱勇破之。

translations.literal: Murong Wei broke Xinquan stockade and again attacked Hui prefecture; officer Zhu Yong defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Wei broke Xinquan stockade and again hit Hui; officer Zhu Yong defeated him.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，置兩淮、江東西、湖廣京西三道總領軍馬錢糧官，仍掌報發御前軍馬文字。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinchou: overall command officers for military funds and grain on the two Huai, Jiang east and west, and Huguang Jingxi routes were established, still handling documents for dispatching Imperial Front troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinchou: overall officers for army funds and grain were set on the two Huai, Jiang east and west, and Huguang Jingxi, still handling Imperial Front dispatch papers.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賻恤戰沒將士。

translations.literal: Day guimao: funeral stipends were granted to officers and soldiers killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, stipends were paid to officers and soldiers killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣張俊、岳飛于楚州巡視邊防。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Zhang Jun and Yue Fei were sent to Chuzhou to inspect frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhang Jun and Yue Fei were sent to Chuzhou to inspect the frontier.

sentences.zh: 召劉光世赴行在。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命樞密行府置司鎮江，令遍行巡曆措置。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Privy Council field office was ordered to set up headquarters at Zhenjiang and tour everywhere to arrange affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Privy Council field office was posted at Zhenjiang and told to tour the lines and set things in order.

sentences.zh: 庚申，加楊沂中檢校少保、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Yang Yizhong was given acting Junior Guardian and Palace Gate Equivalence to the Three Masters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Yang Yizhong was made acting Junior Guardian with palace-gate honors equal to the Three Masters.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，造克敵弓。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: enemy-defeating bows were made.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai: enemy-defeating bows were manufactured.

sentences.zh: 加秦檜特進，進尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Qin Hui was advanced to extraordinary advance, promoted to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, co-equal councillor, and concurrent Privy Council commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui was raised to extraordinary advance, made Left Vice Director, co-equal councillor, and concurrent Privy Council commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，張俊、岳飛至楚州。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Zhang Jun and Yue Fei reached Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Zhang Jun and Yue Fei reached Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 俊以海州城不可守，毀之，遷其民，統韓世忠軍還鎮江，惟背嵬一軍赴行在。

translations.literal: Jun deemed Haizhou indefensible, destroyed it, moved its people, led Han Shizhong's army back to Zhenjiang, and sent only the Back Mountain army to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Jun held Haizhou untenable, razed it, moved the people, took Han Shizhong's army back to Zhenjiang, and sent only the Back Mountain corps to court.

sentences.zh: 甲申，知河南府李興部兵至鄂州，以興爲左軍統制。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Henan prefect Li Xing brought troops to Ezhou and was made left-army controller.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Li Xing of Henan marched to Ezhou and was made left-army controller.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，明州僧王法恩等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Mingzhou monk Wang Fa'en and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Mingzhou monk Wang Fa'en and others plotted revolt and were executed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，劉光世罷爲萬壽觀使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Liu Guangshi was dismissed and made Wanshou Palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Liu Guangshi was dismissed and made Wanshou Palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，秦檜上《徽宗實錄》，進修撰以下各一官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuxu: Qin Hui presented the Veritable Records of Huizong; compilers from reviser down each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuxu: Qin Hui submitted the Veritable Records of Huizong; every compiler from reviser down was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以翰林學士范同參知政事。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Hanlin academician Fan Tong was made participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Hanlin academician Fan Tong became participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 以旱，減膳祈禱，遣官決滯獄，出系囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, meals were reduced for prayer; officials were sent to clear delayed cases and release imprisoned criminals.
translations.idiomatic: In drought, the court cut meals for prayer, sent men to clear delayed cases, and released prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加秦檜少保。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Qin Hui was given Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Qin Hui was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷劉錡兵，命知荊南府。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Liu Qi's command was ended; he was ordered to govern Jingnan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liu Qi was stripped of troops and ordered to govern Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔優獎永興、鳳翔、秦隴等州縣官，到任半年減磨勘，任滿遷一官。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict specially rewarded officials of Yongxing, Fengxiang, Qin-Long, and other prefectures and counties—half a year off advancement review on taking post, one rank on term completion.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, officials of Yongxing, Fengxiang, Qin-Long, and the like were favored: six months less on review at arrival, one rank up when terms ended.

sentences.zh: 己未，加張俊太傅。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhang Jun was given Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhang Jun was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大雨。

translations.literal: Day guihai: heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，命張俊復如鎮江措置軍務，留岳飛行在。

translations.literal: That month Zhang Jun was again ordered to Zhenjiang to arrange military affairs; Yue Fei was kept at the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun was sent back to Zhenjiang to handle the armies; Yue Fei was kept at court.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，立祚德廟于臨安，祀韓厥。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: Zude Temple was established at Lin'an to sacrifice to Han Que.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuchen: Zude Temple was built at Lin'an to honor Han Que.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷岳飛。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Yue Fei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Yue Fei was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命諸王后各推年長一人權主祀事。

translations.literal: Day yihai: each royal prince's house was ordered to choose its eldest to preside over sacrifices pro tempore.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, each prince's house was to name its eldest to preside over rites for the time being.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，胡世將起復。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Hu Shijiang resumed office after mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Hu Shijiang returned from mourning.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，命軍器少監鮑琚如鄂州根括宣撫司錢谷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: Arms Bureau vice intendant Bao Ju was sent to Ezhou to audit Pacification Commission grain and funds.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao: Arms Bureau vice intendant Bao Ju was sent to Ezhou to audit pacification funds and grain.

sentences.zh: 鄂州前軍副統制王俊告副都統制張憲謀據襄陽爲變，張俊收憲屬吏以聞。

translations.literal: Ezhou forward-army deputy controller Wang Jun accused deputy overall controller Zhang Xian of plotting to hold Xiangyang in revolt; Zhang Jun took Xian into custody as a subordinate official and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Ezhou forward deputy Wang Jun charged deputy overall Zhang Xian with seizing Xiangyang in revolt; Zhang Jun seized Xian and reported.

sentences.zh: 丁未，坐監司不按贓吏罪。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: oversight commissioners were punished for not prosecuting corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, circuit overseers were punished for failing to prosecute corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吳璘拔秦州，州將武誼降。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Wu Lin took Qin prefecture; prefectural officer Wu Yi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wu Lin took Qin; prefectural officer Wu Yi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬子，璘率姚仲及金人戰于丁劉圈，敗之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Lin led Yao Zhong against the Jin at Dingliucun and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lin with Yao Zhong fought the Jin at Dingliucun and broke them.

sentences.zh: 楊政克隴州，破岐下諸屯。

translations.literal: Yang Zheng took Long prefecture and broke the stockades below Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zheng took Long and smashed the camps below Qi.

sentences.zh: 郭浩復華州，入陝州。

translations.literal: Guo Hao recovered Hua prefecture and entered Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao retook Hua and entered Shan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，建康大火。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a great fire in Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Jiankang suffered a great fire.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣劉光遠等充金國通問使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Liu Guangyuan and others were sent as Jin rapport envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Guangyuan and others were sent as envoys to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 吳璘及金人戰于剡家灣，大敗之，遂圍臘家城。

translations.literal: Wu Lin fought the Jin at Yanjiawan, routed them heavily, and besieged Lajia stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin met the Jin at Yanjiawan, routed them, and besieged Lajia.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，璘自臘家城受詔班師，楊政、郭浩皆引軍還。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Lin received orders to withdraw from Lajia; Yang Zheng and Guo Hao all led troops back.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lin was ordered to pull back from Lajia; Yang Zheng and Guo Hao withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，邵隆復虢州，郝晸討禽駱科，斬之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Shao Long recovered Guo prefecture; Hao Jing pursued and captured Luo Ke and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Shao Long retook Guo; Hao Jing ran down Luo Ke and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，金人陷泗州，遂陷楚州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingyin new moon: the Jin took Sizhou and then Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingyin new moon: the Jin took Sizhou, then Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命樞密都承旨鄭剛中宣諭川、陝。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Privy Council chief steward Zheng Gangzhong was ordered to proclaim the court's will in Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Privy Council chief steward Zheng Gangzhong was sent to proclaim the throne's will in Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，楊政及金人戰于寶雞縣，敗之，禽通檢孛堇。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Yang Zheng fought the Jin at Baoji county, defeated them, and captured military inspector Boluo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yang Zheng fought the Jin at Baoji, routed them, and seized military inspector Boluo.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，兀朮遣劉光遠等還。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Wuzhu sent Liu Guangyuan and others back.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wuzhu sent Liu Guangyuan and his party back.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔修玉牒。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict ordered repair of the imperial genealogy rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the imperial genealogy rolls were ordered repaired.

sentences.zh: 下岳飛、張憲大理獄，命御史中丞何鑄、大理卿週三畏鞫之。

translations.literal: Yue Fei and Zhang Xian were put in Dali prison; investigating censor-in-chief He Zhu and Dali director Zhou Sanwei were ordered to try them.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei and Zhang Xian were sent to Dali prison; censor-in-chief He Zhu and Dali director Zhou Sanwei were to try them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣魏良臣、王公亮爲金國稟議使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Wei Liangchen and Wang Gongliang were sent as Jin deliberation envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wei Liangchen and Wang Gongliang were sent as Jin deliberation envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，虛恨蠻主曆階詣嘉州降。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Xuhuan chieftain Li Jie came to Jia prefecture to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xuhuan chief Li Jie came to Jia to surrender.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，韓世忠罷爲醴泉觀使，封福國公。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Han Shizhong was dismissed and made Liquan Palace attendant, enfeoffed Duke of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Han Shizhong was dismissed, made Liquan Palace attendant, and enfeoffed Duke of Fu.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人陷濠州，邵隆復陝州。

translations.literal: That month the Jin took Haozhou; Shao Long recovered Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin took Haozhou; Shao Long retook Shan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，範同罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: Fan Tong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai: Fan Tong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 責降李光爲建寧軍節度副使、藤州安置。

translations.literal: Li Guang was demoted to Jianning military commissioner deputy and settled at Teng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guang was demoted to Jianning deputy commissioner and exiled to Teng.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，兀朮遣審議使蕭毅、邢具瞻與魏良臣等偕來。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Wuzhu sent deliberation envoys Xiao Yi and Xing Juzhan together with Wei Liangchen and others.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wuzhu sent deliberation envoys Xiao Yi and Xing Juzhan with Wei Liangchen and the rest.

sentences.zh: 丁未，范同分司、筠州居住。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Fan Tong held sinecure rank and resided at Yun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Fan Tong held a sinecure and lived at Yun.

sentences.zh: 罷判大宗正事士㒟、同知宗正事士撙，申嚴戚裏宗室謁禁。

translations.literal: Supervisory intendant of the Great Imperial Clan Shi Yi and associate clan director Shi Zun were dismissed; visits by affinal kin and imperial clansmen were strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Great Imperial Clan intendant Shi Yi and associate director Shi Zun were dismissed; visits by in-laws and clansmen were tightened.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雷。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, thunder.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蕭毅等入見，始定議和盟誓。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Xiao Yi and others had audience; the peace covenant was first settled.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Xiao Yi and others were received; the peace covenant was first fixed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以何鑄簽書樞密院事，充金國報謝進誓表使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: He Zhu was made Privy Council signatory and sent as Jin envoy to return thanks and present the covenant memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, He Zhu became Privy Council signatory and was sent to the Jin to give thanks and deliver the covenant memorial.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命宰執及議誓撰文官告祭天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the chief ministers and covenant-drafting officials were ordered to report to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, chief ministers and covenant drafters were told to announce the pact to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以張浚爲檢校少傅、崇信軍節度使、萬壽觀使。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Zhang Jun was made acting Junior Mentor, Chongxin military commissioner, and Wanshou Palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Jun was made acting Junior Mentor, Chongxin commissioner, and Wanshou Palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 是月，與金國和議成，立盟書，約以淮水中流畫疆，割唐、鄧二州界之，歲奉銀二十五萬兩、絹二十五萬匹，休兵息民，各守境土。

translations.literal: That month peace with Jin was concluded; a covenant was drawn stating the border at the Huai River's midstream, with Tang and Deng prefectures ceded on the frontier, annual tribute of 250,000 taels silver and 250,000 bolts silk, cessation of arms and rest for the people, each side guarding its territory.
translations.idiomatic: That month peace with the Jin was sealed: border at mid-Huai, Tang and Deng given up, 250,000 taels silver and 250,000 bolts silk yearly, arms stilled and people rested, each realm holding its ground.

sentences.zh: 詔川、陝宣撫司毋出兵生事，招納叛亡。

translations.literal: The Sichuan-Shaanxi Pacification Commission was forbidden to send troops to stir trouble or recruit defectors.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office was barred from raiding or sheltering deserters.

sentences.zh: 駱科餘黨歐幻四等復叛桂陽藍山，犯平陽縣，遣江西兵馬都監程師回討平之。

translations.literal: Luo Ke's remnant followers Ou Huan and others rebelled again at Guiyang and Lanshan, struck Pingyang county; Jiangxi troop supervisor Cheng Shihui was sent to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Ke's remnant Ou Huan and others rose at Guiyang and Lanshan and hit Pingyang; Jiangxi troop supervisor Cheng Shihui was sent to crush them.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，責降徽猷閣待制劉洪道爲濠州團練副使使、柳州安置。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: Liu Hongdao, Huayou Pavilion attendant, was demoted to Haozhou training deputy commissioner and settled at Liu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingmao: Huayou attendant Liu Hongdao was demoted to Haozhou training deputy and exiled to Liu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命尚書省置籍勾考諸路滯獄。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Masters of Writing was ordered to register and audit delayed cases on each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Masters of Writing was to register and review stalled cases on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷川、陝宣撫司便宜行事。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Sichuan-Shaanxi Pacification Commission's discretionary authority was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office lost discretionary powers.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，兀朮遣何鑄等如會甯見金主，且趣割陝西餘地。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Wuzhu sent He Zhu and others to Huining to see the Jin emperor and press for cession of the remaining Shaanxi lands.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wuzhu sent He Zhu and others to Huining to see the Jin ruler and demand the rest of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 遂命周聿、莫將、鄭剛中分畫京西唐鄧、陝西地界。

translations.literal: Zhou Yu, Mo Jiang, and Zheng Gangzhong were then ordered to demarcate the Jingxi Tang-Deng and Shaanxi frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Yu, Mo Jiang, and Zheng Gangzhong were told to mark the Jingxi Tang-Deng and Shaanxi borders.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命州縣三歲一置產業簿

translations.literal: Day renwu: prefectures and counties were ordered every three years to compile property registers
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, prefectures and counties were ordered every three years to compile property registers

translations.literal: Day dinghai: regulations for inspecting seagoing ships were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, rules for inspecting seagoing ships were enacted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜岳飛死于大理寺，斬其子雲及張憲于市，家屬徙廣南，官屬于鵬等論罪有差。
